title: shell-tools
label: CLI
desc: jq, fzf, ripgrep, fd, bat, xargs, find and sed/awk for everyday shell work.

sections.title: JSON with jq
sections.description: Read, filter and reshape JSON from files or stdin.

snippets.code:
# Pretty-print, read a field, list keys
jq '.' package.json
jq -r '.name' package.json
jq '.dependencies | keys[]' package.json
jq -c '.scripts' package.json            # compact, one line

# Build a new object and format fields into text
curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/jqlang/jq | jq '{name, stars: .stargazers_count, lang: .language}'
jq -r '.items[] | "\(.id)\t\(.title)"' feed.json

sections.title: jq Recipes
sections.description: Grouping, filtering, merging and defaults for real payloads.

snippets.code:
# Count by status, filter, then take the top three
jq -r 'group_by(.status)[] | "\(.[0].status): \(length)"' orders.json
jq '[.[] | select(.total > 1000)] | length' orders.json
jq 'sort_by(-.total) | .[0:3] | .[] | {id, total}' orders.json

# Deep merge, drop secrets, apply defaults, inject a variable
jq -s '.[0] * .[1]' base.json override.json
jq 'del(.password, .token)' user.json
jq '.retries // 3' config.json
jq --arg env production '.env = $env' config.json

sections.title: Fuzzy Finding
sections.description: Fuzzy-pick from any list, with a live preview of the selection.

snippets.code:
# Pipe any list into fzf and read the pick on stdout
git branch --format='%(refname:short)' | fzf --height 40% --reverse
ls *.log | fzf --preview 'tail -n 20 {}'

# Defaults apply to every fzf invocation
export FZF_DEFAULT_COMMAND='fd --type f --hidden --exclude .git'
export FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS='--height 40% --layout=reverse --border'

# Rebuild the list on a key press
fd --type f | fzf --query '.rs$' --bind 'ctrl-r:reload(fd --type f)'

sections.title: Ripgrep
sections.description: Recursive search that respects .gitignore and is fast by default.

snippets.code:
rg -n 'TODO|FIXME' src/            # line numbers, recursive by default
rg -i 'timeout' --type rust        # case-insensitive, by file type
rg -l 'deprecated' .               # file names only
rg -C 2 'fn main' src/main.rs      # two lines of context

rg --files -g '*.json'                    # list files, skip content search
rg -w 'test' -g '!target' -g '!node_modules'
rg -U --multiline-dotall 'struct \w+ \{[^}]+\}' src/
rg 'localhost' -r '127.0.0.1' --passthru  # preview a replacement

sections.title: fd
sections.description: A find replacement with saner defaults and parallel command execution.

snippets.code:
fd 'test'                        # case-insensitive substring on file names
fd -e rs -x wc -l                # one command per result
fd -e png -X file                # one command with every result appended
fd -H -I -t f -d 2 '^\.env'      # hidden, no ignore rules, files, depth 2

fd -t d '^src$' --max-results 1
fd -e md --changed-within 7d
fd -0 -e json | xargs -0 jq -r '.name'

sections.title: bat
sections.description: cat with syntax highlighting, line numbers and git markers.

snippets.code:
bat src/main.rs          # highlight plus header and line numbers
bat -n src/main.rs       # line numbers only
bat -p src/main.rs       # plain output, no decorations
bat --diff src/main.rs   # show uncommitted changes in the gutter

bat -l json config.json                # force a syntax when the name is unclear
bat -r 40:60 src/main.rs               # print a line range
bat --theme='Monokai Extended' --style=numbers,changes src/main.rs
bat --list-themes | fzf --preview 'bat --theme={} --color=always src/main.rs'

sections.title: xargs
sections.description: Turn stdin into arguments, in batches or in parallel.

snippets.code:
printf '%s\n' a b c | xargs -n 1 echo      # one argument per invocation
fd -e jpg -0 | xargs -0 -P 4 -n 1 gzip     # four parallel jobs
cat urls.txt | xargs -I{} curl -sO {}      # substitute instead of appending

# -t echoes the command, -r skips execution on empty input
fd -e log | xargs -t -n 1 rm
fd -e log | xargs -r rm

sections.title: Find
sections.description: Portable traversal for age, size and exec conditions.

snippets.code:
find . -name '*.log' -mtime +7 -delete
find src -type f -name '*.rs' -newer Cargo.toml
find . -type d -name node_modules -prune -o -name '*.ts' -print
find . -maxdepth 1 -type f -size +10M -printf '%s\t%p\n' | sort -rn

sections.title: sed and awk
sections.description: Line-range edits with sed, column math and filtering with awk.

snippets.code:
sed -n '10,20p' access.log                       # print a line range
sed -i.bak 's/localhost/127.0.0.1/g' config.yml  # in place, keeps a backup
sed '/^#/d; /^$/d' config.yml                    # drop comments and blanks

awk -F, '{ sum += $3 } END { print sum }' sales.csv
awk '$9 == 500 { print $7 }' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head
awk 'NR > 1 { print $1, $NF }' report.txt        # skip the header row

sections.title: Pipelines
sections.description: Compose the tools, and check each stage before trusting the chain.

snippets.code:
# Most frequent errors in a log
rg -o 'ERROR \w+' app.log | awk '{ print $2 }' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -10
# Largest files in the current tree
du -ah . | sort -rh | head -20

# Build a pipeline one stage at a time
rg --files -g '*.rs' | head -5
rg --files -g '*.rs' | wc -l
rg --files -g '*.rs' | xargs wc -l | tail -1

sections.title: Common Errors
sections.description: The failure modes that waste the most time, and the one-flag fix.

snippets.code:
# jq "Cannot index string with number": check the type before indexing
echo '{"id":1}' | jq 'type'
# rg "regex parse error": search literally instead of escaping meta characters
rg -F 'a.b(' src/ || echo 'no literal match'
# fd finds nothing because .gitignore hides the path
fd -I -H -e env --max-results 3

# bat writes escape codes into a pipe: decorate off when piping
bat --style=plain --color=never file.md | head -5
# sed -i needs an explicit backup suffix on macOS
sed -i '' 's/foo/bar/g' file.txt
